newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta Air cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Delta Air cut to neutral.

text.p: Dillon Read said it downgraded Delta Air Lines Inc to neutral from outperform based on new cost guidance from the company.
-- said cut fiscal 1998 earnings estimates to $10 a share from $11 a share.
-- said believes the airline industry as a whole is seeing the peak in unit revenues.
-- said Delta on Thursday gave analysts "cost guidance that was higher than we had anticipated."

-- On Thursday, Delta named two interim officers to run the company as it seeks for a replacement for retiring chairman Ronald Allen. Delta also posted fourth quarter earnings that failed to meet analysts' expectations.
